final: SELECT sc.zoneref, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) as record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanconservation sc2 JOIN sites s2 ON sc2.zoneref = s2.zoneregistry) as fraction FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY fraction DESC, s.insurstat IS NULL, sc.zoneref ASC, s.insurstat ASC LIMIT 10
